briefing.geography: The Mare Claim rim-and-flat terrain with a landing yard at one end and the listening-probe crater at the other.
goals: Cross from the landing yard to the listening-probe crater.
Build at the two surveyed grounds on opposite ends of the Far Side.
rules: Earth is absent from the sky.
The Far Side reuses the Mare Claim rim-and-flat ground.
Waves enter from the north, west, and east.
The crossing is not made until four separate entries into the listening-probe crater are credited with air still in the suit.
Only one crossing counts in each four-wave window, so the vacuum is crossed again and again; an entry made on an empty suit counts for nothing.
The hero makes the crossing herself. Her suit holds sixty seconds of air and only the landing yard fills it; the crater lies sixty-eight paces out.
An empty suit costs her five hit points every second until she reaches air.

buildables.meaning: Lights the dark and slows what it touches; radius 8wu.
Timber that holds. Bandits break it before you.
Works the river for you: 3g per cycle beside water.
Holds +150 gold above the pan cap.
Spark bolts, line-of-sight, 16wu range.
Write orders; the town's craftsmen answer. One per claim.

data.consequence: the hero's suit holds 60s of air outside pressurised ground and refills only inside it at 4s per second; once it empties she loses 5hp every second until she reaches air or dies

the run cannot secure until the hero has stood in every authored crossing zone on air AND 4 crossings have been credited, and only ONE crossing counts per 4-wave window, so the vacuum is crossed across the whole contract; an entry made breathless is counted and credits nothing
